title: Story premise ENT017: The Perfect Snowman Symmetry War
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (two-person rivalry). Hook: One more correction and it will be perfect. Takeaway/theme: A pursuit of precision can erase the thing you liked.
description: Two builders compete to make a toy snow figure more symmetrical, shaving away every uneven bump until the entire sculpture becomes a pebble. They stop measuring, rebuild it with deliberately mismatched arms, and discover its lopsided wave is the best part.
